scope_limits: This is an explicit one-time QA input, not a release approval or a default CI dependency.
Without the exact opt-in label and repository/PR/head/base scope, no baseline is downloaded.
An expired artifact or mismatched source, version, ZIP or EXE hash must fail; never substitute another package.
The current separately paired helper seeds fixed synthetic V1 data using unchanged production NodeStore sources; it is not the historical application writer.
Actual old and new installers and ordinary application launches are observed on one disposable standard-user profile; original private profiles and live providers are not tested.
